title: Service discovery and registries

kcs.statement: Service discovery keeps a registry of the live network locations of service instances, updated when instances register on start and removed when they stop or fail health probes.
In client-side discovery the caller queries the registry and picks an instance itself; in server-side discovery the caller sends to a load balancer or gateway that queries the registry for it.
